longDescription: Launchy is the most efficient way to open files, folders, websites, and programs on your computer. Instead of having to browse the menus to find an application, Launchy is a smart search program which tries to guess which program or file you are looking for and will launch it when you hit the enter key. It runs in background and appears when the configured key combination is pressed (Ctrl+Space by default) or the tray icon is clicked.
